title: Machine learning guides synthesis of low-ruthenium perovskite oxygen evolution catalysts
summary: A library of thirty high-to-medium entropy La(Ru,Ni,Mn,Fe)O3 catalysts was synthesised and screened electrochemically; the best low-Ru composition gave 325 mV overpotential at 10 mA cm-2 with 4% decay over 70 h. The data informed machine-learning-guided synthesis of twelve new compositions, and La1.02Ru0.16Ni0.36Mn0.12Fe0.34O3 reached 269 mV, a Tafel slope of 62 mV dec-1 and over 90% voltage retention after 85 h. The abstract does not name the machine-learning algorithm; the library is small.
ai_technology: Machine-learning model trained on electrochemical screening data to propose new compositions

evidence.tested: Synthesis, X-ray diffraction and electrochemical testing of the twelve machine-learning-proposed compositions.
evidence.unknown: Algorithm identity, model accuracy and scalability beyond the small library; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning model trained on screening results guided the next synthesis round.
